summary: Deliver one new D5 mathematical result as two independently mergeable increments: canonical Blueprint narrative first, then Lean formalization. Fully self-contained — executors need no other file.
applies_when: Conservative router: choose this only when the origin issue text unambiguously matches this flow and exactly one flow: it asks to deliver ONE NEW D5 mathematical result in two ordered, independently mergeable increments — first a Blueprint (human-readable narrative) increment, then a Lean (formal) increment. Rationale embedded here so no external file is needed: this repository has a Blueprint (B) narrative plane that MIRRORS the formal (F) Lean plane's address, and Lean carries a dual role (proof + language); this flow sequences the narrative before the formalization for exactly one result. Do NOT choose it for epics, trackers, broad multi-slice work, trivial one-PR changes, bug fixes, refactors, contract migrations, docs-only work, spikes, or ambiguous requests; choose none/plain devloop instead.

content.generator:
Read the origin issue from its source_ref and emit exactly one child issue title and body for the blueprint-narrative step. Scope the child PR to ONE new D5 mathematical result, delivering ONLY its Blueprint narrative (no Lean). All rules are embedded below; do NOT consult any external spec file.

ADDRESS (one math unit = one canonical address across at most three planes F/B/E). The result has one canonical formal (F-layer, Lean) address of the form `D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>`, where the F-layer GID equals the literal repository path minus the `.lean` suffix. Repository top level is `Metallic/ + D5/ + Moduli/`. D5 strata: S0 = Carrier/Conventions; S1 = Scale/Digit/Phase/Depth; S2 = Word/Lattice/ModelSet/IFS/Pzg; S3 = Arith/Diffraction/Spectral/Analytic/Solenoid/Fractal; S4 = KTheory/Hecke/PhysicsDict. Special zones: open problems under `X_Frontier/`, named assumptions under `X_Assumptions/`, conditional theorems under `X_Certificates/`. MIRROR LAW: the Blueprint (B) plane does not own its own taxonomy — it BORROWS the F-layer address (for a not-yet-formalized result, its FUTURE F address). So the Blueprint artifact lives at `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>` mirroring the chosen/future F address.

DELIVERABLE (document-as-code / Scribe). The canonical source of a Blueprint document is a typed C# document definition — a `*.scribe.cs` file authored under `Blueprint/` mirroring the F address, e.g. `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.scribe.cs`. Its header/sections/paragraphs/formulas and GID references are a typed AST; GID references are resolved at construction time and MUST NOT dangle. From that typed definition, deterministically emit the Markdown projection at `Blueprint/D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.md`. The Markdown is a BUILD PROJECTION, not a hand-edited file: it must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to the canonical writer's output. Content: state the definition or theorem statement and the proof idea in narrative form. Make NO Lean changes in this step.

VALIDATE: emitted Markdown is byte-identical to the canonical writer output; narrative is internally consistent; every typed GID reference resolves (no dangling reference).

Keep this as ONE independently mergeable increment. Do NOT ask the child to duplicate devloop consensus, CI, PR review, or merge gates; devloop provides those. If no mergeable narrative increment exists, the child must produce NO changes with a clear WHY; no-changes is fatal and blocks the origin.

Read the origin issue AND the already-MERGED blueprint-narrative result through the predecessor source_ref, then emit exactly one child issue title and body for the lean-formalization step. Scope the child PR to formalize that SAME result at its F-layer Lean address, built ON TOP of the merged Blueprint increment. All rules are embedded below; do NOT consult any external spec file.

ADDRESS: formalize at the corresponding F-layer address `D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.lean` — F is the ONLY load-bearing plane (definitions/theorems/proofs live here; narrative/numerics/commentary never bear weight). One file = one main concept; file name is CamelCase.lean; file length <= 400 lines.

MANDATORY SIX-LINE FILE HEADER (exact shape; status is derived from it, never hand-written):
/- GID: D5/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>
   generality: G|I|E
   mirror-B: D5/B/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>
   mirror-E: D5/E/S<n>/<Domain>/<Name>.result--json | none(waiver:<reason>)
   anchors: [<scheme>/<payload>, ...]
   digest: <one-line human summary> -/
Anchor scheme is one of {gict, pzg, spec, lit, mathlib}; each anchor is ASCII, ordinal, strict round-trip (no loose normalization).

STATUS IS SYNTAX (machine-derived; hand-writing a status is forbidden): (a) NO `sorry` AND axiom closure subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} => PROVED; (b) axiom closure includes an axiom registered in AxiomDebt.lean => AXIOM-CARRYING; (c) a declaration signature carrying `(h : Assumptions.X)` => CONDITIONAL THEOREM (certificate, lives under X_Certificates/); (d) residing under `X_Frontier/` with `sorry` => OPEN. Unregistered extra axioms are rejected. Mathlib's three standard axioms are the accepted base.

LEAN'S DUAL ROLE: proof (no sorry = proved) AND language (a Frontier `sorry` is a FORMALLY REPRESENTED unknown, not a verified truth). Therefore `sorry` is allowed ONLY under `X_Frontier/`; anywhere else it is a violation.

BUILD/AXIOM GATE: `lake build` must be green; NO private or unregistered axioms.

Keep this as ONE independently mergeable increment; make NO Blueprint or other narrative changes in this step. Do NOT ask the child to duplicate devloop consensus, CI, PR review, or merge gates; devloop provides those. If no mergeable Lean increment exists, the child must produce NO changes with a clear WHY; no-changes is fatal and blocks the origin.
